title: Four dead, two injured in California mountain road crash
summary: A vehicle left a mountain road near Wrightwood, California and fell down a steep slope, killing four occupants and injuring two others. Investigators said alcohol was likely a factor in the crash. The California Highway Patrol opened an investigation into the incident. No further details about the vehicle or drivers were provided. The investigation remains ongoing.
summary_points: Vehicle rolled off a mountain road near Wrightwood, California
Four people were killed in the crash
California Highway Patrol is investigating the incident
Investigators said alcohol was likely a factor
